== Description ==

[[Kevin Jaap]] (right, white polo) poses with a player wearing a T-shirt with a printed photograph of Kevin taped to it, in the game room at Zu den Vier Winden on the night of his Hall of Fame induction at the [[2024 World Championship]]. The poster's account: Kevin was talked into a spicy shot "saying all hall of famers have to", the bar printed a photo of his face, and they made a new shirt and staged this photo.

Kevin takes shot. He is recorded. Photo of his face is printed out by bar. They make a new shirt. Help stage a photo of Kevin next to shirt without knowing it."
